# The traceability ledger. Each row maps one compatibility item to its
# class, its compat knob and the tests that cover it.
# Columns: id, class (RE FU DV NO P6), knob (- or
# RE rows keep the legacy behavior. FU rows fix only undefined behavior or
# a crash. DV rows are registered deviations that an application can see.
# NO rows change only the Rust API. P6 rows are not visible to an
# application, so they need no test. The test_ids value pending:windows
# marks a row that only a Windows build can test. The Rust client does
# not support Windows yet, so these rows have no test.
